recipe: Exactly the case30 v4 training configuration of job 8962608, via configs/v4.yaml and configs/v2/stage1.yaml; two fresh OFF runs only
origin_order: All 4090 origins in each of epochs 0,1,2; CPU randperm seed 42+epoch; full 36-origin K64 selection each epoch

restart_points.position: after final epoch-0 optimizer update and before selection; terminate worker normally after atomic save and start a fresh interpreter for selection

allocation_restarts: OFF B restarts within the same allocation at step 4090 before selection. One allocation only; no automatic continuation allocation.
controller_test: Separate small loop fixture with four identical selection scores, patience 3, boundary restart; stopping must occur at epoch 4, best at epoch 1

comparison.rule: For each OFF chain at each of epochs 1,2,3: selection_ES <= historical maximum of the three v4 ON seeds at that epoch + 0.005. No lower bound: improvements pass. All persisted metrics finite; configuration/counters/order/noise and saved/restored state exact.
comparison.justification: User-declared one-sided non-inferiority: the question is only whether OFF is not worse. A two-sided min/max envelope from n=3 rejects an in-distribution draw with probability 2/(n+1)=50% under independent exchangeable continuous draws, and rejects improvements. Slack 0.005 is about 1% of epoch-1 ES, fixed here before this new run and never tightened or loosened afterwards.
comparison.exact_fields: Origin order, sample noise, counters, all configuration except declared run identity/mode differences; final RNG trees; restored model/optimizer/scheduler/RNG equal saved state for every restart
comparison.stopping_epoch_comparison: Dropped from this gate because three epochs cannot test stopping epoch +/-1. Report it from the first full fleet run instead; no fleet job is launched by this confirmation.
comparison.near_zero: Absolute additive slack 0.005 (rtol=0) against historical maxima; no denominator or lower bound.
comparison.monitoring: Check persisted OFF epoch selections every second against the fixed upper bounds; final gate also checks complete three-epoch coverage, finite step metrics and exact restoration/RNG/order/configuration.

case30.report: Median and p90 synchronized production-step seconds; full worker and allocation cost, restart/selection overhead; two independent isolated tiles.

historical_ON_context.interpretation: Previously measured ON timing is contextual, not a new matched ON/OFF comparison.
